subject: ggplot2 Scatter plot: Setting colors of data points according to a variable and plot only one regression line

messages.author: 6d516dae6aab4320
messages.subject: ggplot2 Scatter plot: Setting colors of data points according to a variable and plot only one regression line
parts:
Hey everybody,

I have the following plot in which the colors of the data point are according to exp. However, I want to plot the overall regression line (the one that takes into account all data points) , and not six regression lines (each line for each exp like I have now). Does anyone know how I can achieve that?

scatp <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = wmc, y = nocue3T_3D3T, color = exp)) +
             geom_point(shape = 18, size = 3) +    
             geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE)


Thanks in advance,

Ayala

messages.author: c0e822e430c1a5a7
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 Scatter plot: Setting colors of data points according to a variable and plot only one regression line
parts:
Hi Ayala,

Please try this:

ggplot(dat, aes(x = wmc, y = nocue3T_3D3T)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = exp), shape = 18, size = 3) +
geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE)
